svg.title: Lifting one-dimensional data into two dimensions
svg.desc: Left: points on a line, positives in the middle and negatives on both sides, so no single threshold separates them. Right: the same points plotted at (x, x squared) lie on a parabola, and a straight maximum-margin line now separates the middle points from the outer ones; the support vectors are circled. Pulled back to the line, the straight boundary becomes two thresholds, marked on the left panel.
svg.text: lifted to (x, x²): a straight line separates
